description.en: Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe is restated under Drilling and blasting. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe. The published table prints Part type Straight concrete pump delivery pipe; End connection Reinforced coupling / flange ends; Finish Factory red enamel; Diameter / length Quoted after confirming the pump model. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
